title: Health counters with two-sided bands, and one metrics line in the report
action: Plan Phase 4, first half (per 66c4c251 and a8f4b8ab). Add a health-counter surface to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/supervisor.rs, computed by the DETERMINISTIC layer only — every number comes from records bee already holds, never from a model and never self-reported. Add `bee supervisor metrics [--window <id>] [--json]`: with no --window it measures the last closed presence window (last_closed_window from sup-8), with --window a named one. Counters, each carrying a TWO-SIDED band (a low bound and a high bound, so 'suspiciously low' reads as loudly as 'too high'), and each carrying an explicit sample count so a band verdict on 2 samples never reads like one on 200: (1) escalations per capped cell in the window; (2) blocked rate — blocked cells over claimed cells; (3) wrong-assumption rate — decision-log events in the window that were later superseded, over all decision events in the window; (4) self-answered band — silence observations over all observations (a supervisor that never speaks and one that never stays quiet are both out of band); (5) earned-autonomy streak — consecutive capped cells with zero human-reversed one-way decisions, per 66c4c251, reported as a NUMBER only: code never raises a consent level, that switch stays the human's; (6) overrun — 2x-estimate per a8f4b8ab, SKIP-UNTIL-PRESENT per decision ea02cb68: compute it only for a cell that already records an estimate, and where none does, report the counter as the literal state 'no estimate recorded', never zero and never a guess; (7) same-region repeat — consecutive capped cells whose trace.files_changed sets are identical, which is the derivable form of a8f4b8ab's two-submissions-differ-in-one-region signal. Each counter verdict is one of below-band | in-band | above-band | not-measurable, and 'not-measurable' is a first-class outcome that is never silently rendered as in-band. Every band bound is a named const with a one-line comment saying why that number, so the bands are readable and arguable rather than magic. Then wire ONE compact line into the sup-9 WakeReport: the report's 10-line ceiling and four sections do not change — the metrics block occupies exactly ONE of the existing content lines, listing only counters whose verdict is out of band or not-measurable, and reading 'metrics in band' when every counter is healthy. Tests in the same tests module: each counter computes off planted records; a below-band value is flagged, not just an above-band one; a zero-sample counter reports not-measurable; a cell with no recorded estimate reports 'no estimate recorded'; the report still fits its ceiling with the metrics line present; the streak is a number and no config value changes. Regen deferred to the wave barrier.

a counter with no usable input reports not-measurable, never zero or in-band

blocked-rate takes its denominator as the union of cells claimed in the window and cells blocked in it, not literally claimed cells: a real swept-blocked cell (.bee/cells/mdp-1.json) has claimed_at null, so blocked-over-claimed can exceed 1 and is not derivable — the plan was wrong about a fact
